required_inputs: volume; measured or classified DM%; season; application method; soil P/K index
equation_or_rule: volume × Teagasc agronomic available-N/P/K value, with applicable index adjustment
missing_input_behaviour: estimated only if explicit default accepted; otherwise request slurry analysis/DM
must_not_do: Do not use statutory deemed N/P coefficients as the agronomic replacement value.

required_inputs: manure type; volume/mass; P index; current ruleset
equation_or_rule: statutory total nutrient value × statutory availability where required
must_not_do: Do not substitute a Teagasc agronomic replacement value into legal ledger.

required_inputs: legal_gate=PERMITTED; SMD/drainage; crop demand; weather; nutrient need
equation_or_rule: categorical evidence-based suitability; no unvalidated probability
must_not_do: No arbitrary 0–100 scientific risk probability until externally validated.

required_inputs: stored feed quantity; measured/estimated fresh mass; DM%
equation_or_rule: fresh mass × DM fraction; for bales count × representative mean bale mass × DM fraction
missing_input_behaviour: show ESTIMATED only if assumptions explicitly accepted
must_not_do: Do not double-count ensiling/storage loss after measuring already-stored feed.

required_inputs: supported animal type; target ADG; laboratory silage DMD
equation_or_rule: exact lookup only in validated Teagasc DMD table
missing_input_behaviour: request silage analysis / no exact recommendation
must_not_do: No interpolation or use for different enterprise/animal class without validated evidence.

required_inputs: current liveweight; target date; sale route/spec; projected ADG; feed/housing costs; price scenario; farmer intent
equation_or_rule: incremental expected sale value minus incremental feed/housing/finance/other costs; scenario analysis
output: economic scenarios, NOT autonomous sell instruction
primary_source: farm data + CSO/Bord Bia/DAFM + validated performance model
must_not_do: Never infer 'sell now' from market price alone.

required_inputs: crop_group; Morgan_P_mg_L; report precision; valid/current soil-test context
equation_or_rule: classify by literal statutory ranges; if raw value falls in source micro-gap (8.00,8.01] grassland or (10.00,10.01] other crop, emit AMBIGUOUS_STATUTORY_BOUNDARY and use conservative P4 allowance treatment without falsely claiming literal classification
output: P index OR guarded ambiguity state + regulatory allowance treatment
must_not_do: Do not silently change '>8.01' to '>=8.01'; do not round raw lab values just to force a class.

required_inputs: report/sample date; P-index result; report issue date; georef/LPIS where applicable; OM date if OM used
equation_or_rule: apply current Article17 rules including 4-year disregard rule and P-Index-4 persistence exception; apply post-14-Sep-2025 georef/LPIS requirement
output: VALID / INVALID / INDEX4_PERSISTED / MISSING_GEOREF / UNKNOWN + reasons
must_not_do: Do not invalidate an old P4 result merely because four years elapsed; do not treat an undated result as current.

required_inputs: laboratory lime requirement/buffer-derived LR; crop/soil context; report date; statutory high-GSR context where relevant
equation_or_rule: use lab LR; separately apply current statutory high-stocking lime programme/transitional timing if triggered
output: agronomic lime plan + compliance timing state
missing_input_behaviour: No exact t/ha from pH alone; request lab LR
must_not_do: Never manufacture t/ha from pH.

required_inputs: current statutory livestock categories/counts/time basis; eligible grassland area
equation_or_rule: sum statutory grazing-livestock N produced before exports / entire eligible grassland area
must_not_do: Never subtract manure exports before computing this statutory ratio.

required_inputs: milk-yield band; whether valid Table7a CP election applies; annual average concentrate CP as-fed if elected; prescribed records
equation_or_rule: use current Table7 unless valid Table7a election and CP-band conditions are satisfied
missing_input_behaviour: default to current Table7 when Table7a eligibility cannot be proved
must_not_do: Do not grant lower excretion rate merely from an entered feed protein number without statutory election/records.

required_inputs: soil P test; OM status; approved adviser; submitted NMP; required training; stocking/derogation/non-grass conditions
equation_or_rule: all mandatory Article17(6) conditions + relevant table footnotes must pass before Table15b values can be selected
must_not_do: Never infer eligibility because soil is Index1/2.

required_inputs: milking platform declaration; platform stocking rate; applicable platform chemical-N allowance; year/effective rules
equation_or_rule: lookup current Table14 amount of dairy organic N to move outside platform
output: kg organic N/ha to move + threshold band
missing_input_behaviour: BLOCK dairy high-intensity distribution compliance result
must_not_do: Do not use holding-wide stocking rate in place of defined milking-platform rate.

required_inputs: date; county; material; current dynamic exception event if any; ground status; heavy-rain forecast; slope/runoff context; buffer context
equation_or_rule: baseline closed period + any authoritative ministerial exceptional criteria event + all other legal prohibitions; any stop wins
must_not_do: Never infer an exceptional opening from favourable weather; it requires an authoritative published event.

required_inputs: supported animal class; headcount; farmer-planned winter months
equation_or_rule: headcount × planned months × current Teagasc t fresh pit silage/animal/month coefficient
missing_input_behaviour: BLOCK unsupported class or missing planned months
must_not_do: Do not present this as an energy/protein requirement or individual-animal DMI equation.

required_inputs: animal group; headcount; housing days; validated group/stage intake model or measured feeding record; forage DM basis
equation_or_rule: Σ(head × days × supported forage-DM requirement) for exact nutrition-level model
missing_input_behaviour: Use BASIC_FODDER_DEMAND_FRESH_WEIGHT for supported planning classes; otherwise block exact DM/nutrition result
must_not_do: Do not use 2% liveweight as a universal feed engine.

required_inputs: supply and demand on SAME basis (fresh weight or DM); explicit reserve strategy; wastage treatment
equation_or_rule: surplus = usable supply - demand - explicit reserve; if DM basis, days_cover = usable DM / daily DM demand; if fresh-weight planning basis, report months/tonnes only unless conversion is supported
missing_input_behaviour: BLOCK if units/basis are mixed or either side is unsupported
must_not_do: Never compare tonnes fresh weight directly to tonnes DM; never double-count conservation/wastage loss or reserve.

required_inputs: field commonage status; proposed nutrient/application
equation_or_rule: if commonage=true: chemical fertiliser prohibited; organic-N stocking allowance <=50 kg N/ha
must_not_do: Do not treat commonage as ordinary grassland.

required_inputs: GSR; slurry origin; land use; method; H&S exception evidence
equation_or_rule: apply Article19 LESS triggers and documented exception
must_not_do: Do not assume LESS merely to get a higher agronomic N credit.

required_inputs: area; prior 42-day volume; proposed volume; application rate
equation_or_rule: cumulative litres/ha <=50000 in 42d and rate <=5 mm/hour, plus other rules
must_not_do: Do not ignore prior 42-day applications.

required_inputs: previous-year livestock-manure N; concentrate amount; P content if known
equation_or_rule: threshold=300kg concentrate per92kg manure-N; count P on excess; unknown P content=0.5kg/100kg default
missing_input_behaviour: BLOCK if manure-N or concentrate amount missing
must_not_do: Do not count all concentrate P without threshold.

required_inputs: date; grazing status; animal class/age; concentrate CP%
equation_or_rule: 15 Apr–30 Sep dairy cows and cattle >=2 years at grass: maximum 14% CP in concentrate
must_not_do: Do not let feed optimiser breach this cap.

required_inputs: silage destination; GSR/no-livestock status; cut; sale evidence; P index
equation_or_rule: select Table16/17 only when exact sale conditions pass; otherwise ordinary route
must_not_do: Do not treat all silage fields identically.

required_inputs: formulation; physical form; ureic-N%; inhibitor status; P content; legal route
equation_or_rule: apply current uninhibited solid-urea exclusion before product optimisation
must_not_do: Do not infer inhibitor status from product name.

required_inputs: calculation run; inputs; steps; rules/models; sources; compliance; assumptions; gaps; decision status
equation_or_rule: persist immutable trace at calculation time; reports serialize stored trace
must_not_do: Do not reverse-engineer an old rationale with an LLM.
